authority.quote: 你可以在新独占登记中先做一次 CPU-only、无发布的完整 8+2 秒工程诊断，无需再问我；执行前须统一 P1→P2 的明确准入规则，核实当前源码身份、本人进程及目标 CPU 核负载，重新测可用 RAM，并在导入 JAX 前锁定 CPU 环境。GPU 仍繁忙时不启动任何 GPU 依赖阶段。诊断要保留超时、退出和回收原件；它通过后，再登记可发布请求，不把诊断补写成 PASS。
interpretation: This registration is the 'new exclusive registration' named in the authorization.
Latitude granted: execute this one diagnostic without asking again.
Constraint: CPU-only, no publication, no GPU-dependent stage, keep timeout/exit/reap originals.
Forbidden: rewriting or completing this diagnostic into a PASS by hand; using it as a PASS for any publishable-request gate.

exclusive_namespace.rule: no other run may write into remote_output; existing FAIL artifacts elsewhere are read-only

predecessor_artifacts.delivery/actual_loaded_closure_request_r: preserved, NOT released for publication (user: 暂不放行现有登记作为可发布的完整请求)
predecessor_artifacts.delivery/cpu_only_8plus2_diagnostic_root: the unified P1->P2 admission rule; verified locally 6 pass / 0 fail before this registration

resolved_defect.defect: the earlier three-point test judged publication allowed on a stable P2->P3 while P1->P2 had gained a lazily imported file, contradicting the registration clause '任意相邻捕获不同即拒绝'
resolved_defect.resolution: phase boundaries are declared explicitly; P0->P1 is informational (the declared warm-up exists to provoke lazy loading), P1->P2 and P2->P3 are gated; publication is refused unless BOTH gated adjacencies qualify
resolved_defect.single_source_of_truth: unified_closure_protocol.py is imported by the server executor; the executor contains no second copy of the gating logic

declared_unit_of_work.definition: one model chain = encode_cvrp(51 nodes, B=1) followed by decode_edge_logits
declared_unit_of_work.explicitly_not: the complete delivery request; the request-level closure gate remains unqualified by this diagnostic

timed_execution.rule: repeat the declared unit until the 8.0 s budget is reached; per-unit times recorded

recovery_reserve.rule: declared as gc.collect() + release of timed-region temporaries, measured; must be <= 2.0 s

segments.closure_captures: outside the request budget; capture seconds are recorded as an observation, and are NOT used to satisfy the 8 s budget

preconditions_and_gates.cpu_environment_locked: sched_setaffinity to core 15 AND JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu AND CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' AND all *_NUM_THREADS=1, all set BEFORE importing jax
preconditions_and_gates.available_ram_gate: >= 8.0 GiB available, measured in-process before any heavy import
preconditions_and_gates.no_owned_leftover_processes: no other process owned by the login user running python
preconditions_and_gates.cpu_only_no_gpu_device: jax.devices() contains only CPU devices and jax.default_backend() == 'cpu'
preconditions_and_gates.registration_hash_recorded: sha256 of this file recorded inside the run output
preconditions_and_gates.model_loaded: cvrp100.ckpt loaded and the declared unit produced finite logits

pass_rule: gate_pass = true iff every gate in preconditions_and_gates passes; the verdict is computed by the executor process and written into DIAG_STATE.json
failure_handling: a raised exception writes DIAG_FAILURE.json + DIAG_FAILURE.traceback.txt and exits 2
an unmet gate writes DIAG_STATE.json with gate_pass=false and exits 1
either outcome is final for this attempt and must not be edited; a re-attempt requires a new attempt_id
no publication is performed on any outcome
prohibited_in_this_attempt: GPU use or any GPU-dependent stage
post-hoc rewriting of the diagnostic verdict
treating this diagnostic as evidence about utility or about any scientific effect
non_claims: does not qualify a publishable delivery request
does not establish or refute any online gain
measures a model-level unit, not the complete request
